1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said implant is adapted to be implanted in a human shoulder.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface component to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped and has a smooth articulating surface.

10. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface component.

12. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface on said humeral surface component for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface and is adapted for articulation with a glenoid component.

14. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said removably attached stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 14 wherein said removably attached stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular in cross-section.

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem is adapted to have variable length options, wherein different stem lengths are available to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw.

27. (Currently Amended) A glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint, comprising an implant providing a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

30. (Currently Amended) The humerus bone implant of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Currently Amended) The humerus bone implant of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
